item.title: Ex-Pakistan PM Khan taken back to jail after hospital checks
item.description: Former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan was transferred back to jail early on Friday, hours after being taken to a hospital for court-ordered medical checks, the government said. The Supreme Court ordered on Tuesday that Khan, Pakistan's most popular politician, be taken to the private Shifa International Hospital in the capital Islamabad within 48 hours for treatment, after his lawyers petitioned the court over concerns that his health was poor. The ex-cricket captain and his wife Bushra Bibi, who is also his spiritual guide, were both sentenced late last year to 17 years in prison. Publicado también por: The Hindu - International, BBC News - World, Al Jazeera English. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Prince Harry and Meghan to move back to Britain
item.description: Prince Harry and his wife Meghan plan to move back to Britain this month, six years after they stepped down from ​their royal duties and relocated to the US, a source close to the couple said. item.description: Japan executed on Friday a man convicted of an arson attack on a pachinko parlour in 2009 that killed five people, with the prisoner as usual informed shortly before his execution.
